property_summary: After locking a guess h and settling at a block more than 256 past the target block (so blockhash(target) is 0), the contract pays the 2-ether prize exactly when h equals keccak256(abi.encodePacked(bytes32(0))), i.e. the stored guess — not the caller's argument — decides the payout, so the mutant (which never stores the hash) never pays and is caught whenever the fuzzer picks the winning preimage x == 0.
change_summary: Remove the assignment storing the caller's guess hash, leaving the stored guess as zero.
